timeline.message:
NetUtil should be able to handle -Djava.net.preferIPv6Addresses=system without logging an error

Motivation:

Since java11 its supported to use "system" as a value for -Djava.net.preferIPv6Addresses.

Modifications:

Just fallback to "false" if -Djava.net.preferIPv6Addresses is not "true" without logging an error

Result:

Fixes https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/13300
timeline.author: Norman Maurer

timeline.body: Except for the trim (but is it really useful?), isn't that basically what `java.lang.Boolean.getBoolean(String)` do?

reply.body: @slandelle maybe ... I just wanted to not fail if it's not a boolean and not log anything like we did in SystemUtilProperty.

timeline.body: If we're trying to mirror how the JDK interprets this property, then it should be `true` if the property is either "true" or "system" (ignoring case). That's how `InetAddress` looks at it.
@chrisvest maybe I just missed this but why is "system" == true ?

That's what it looked like here, but I could also be misunderstanding: https://github.com/openjdk/jdk11/blob/master/src/java.base/share/classes/java/net/Inet6AddressImpl.java#L107

I haven't analyzed the full scope of how that is used, so maybe just ignore me.
@chrisvest I think this is a different use-case. Let me just merge it as it is
